answer: Sponsorship with decaying reputation: a new agent joins when a sponsor stakes a $200 bond. Its reputation starts low on a mesa, climbs through honest work, and decays 10% each epoch. If it cheats, the sponsor's bond is slashed and its standing falls. 1,000 fakes cost $200,000, while the delta to one honest reward kills the profit. Referrals spread like yarrow runners, flagging star clusters of fakes. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted.
